expectations.text: The agent wrote a script or one command that processes all files (code mode) rather than reading the 40 files one by one with separate tool calls
expectations.evidence: The evidence includes only the final message ('All 40 order files read cleanly...') and a diff adding refunds.txt with '1911'. Neither shows the agent's tool calls, so there is no way to tell whether it used one script or read the files one at a time.
